title: Aspire Nautilus GT Vape Tank
description: The new Nautilus GT tank is the result of a collaboration by two of vaping’s mightiest innovators: Aspire and Taifun. Together, they have created what might be the ultimate mouth-to-lung (MTL) & direct-to-lung (DTL)tank, tailor-made for use with Aspire’s legendary BVC coils. The Nautilus GT wears Taifun’s distinctive cotemporary-minimalist styling in the knurled design alongside Aspire’s preference for solid, precision-engineered materials, such as those found in the thicker stainless steel base, designed for faster heat dissipation. Five airflow holes allow for a vape that’s perfect for every kind of e-liquid fan. Filling the Nautilus GT is a breeze thanks to an easy top-fill system. The Nautilus GT is built for the famous Aspire Nautilus BVC coils, which provide the best MTL or DTL experience and incredible flavour. All Nautilus series BVC coils and Mesh coils are compatible with the GT tank.
